meta.title: Torsion Balance Thrust Stand
meta.description: Torsion balance measures μN–mN thrust with interferometer/capacitive readouts and electrostatic/electromagnetic in-situ calibration, plus thermal compensation and vacuum compatibility for EP calibration and long steady tests.
page.title: Torsion Balance Thrust Stand
page.lead: High-sensitivity micro-thrust stand for μN–mN steady/slow thrust.

detail.overview: Torque-balance stand for micro-thrust, supporting laser interferometer or capacitive/LVDT readouts and electrostatic/electromagnetic calibration. Thermal compensation and vacuum design suit EP calibration and vacuum testing.

detail.feature3: Optional laser interferometer, capacitive, or LVDT readouts
